title: I think this was significant. I taught someone about the mall world in my mall world dream and came up with a theory of it
content: I was telling someone about the mall world, in my mall world 🤯. This was wild. I just woke up and had to share this. Last night I was in mall world and I was dating someone new there who I don’t recognise in real life. It was not my real life partner and it wasn’t anyone I could recognise as being anyone I know either. But in this dream, we were holding hands everywhere and he was being kind of protective. He was taking me to all these places he thought I’d never been to before. The mall, the train station, the hotel, the escalators, the car park, the school, and then the suburban area that leads down to the river. We sat down and we were sitting in front of a window looking on to a view of a garden and a house and some dystopian monument that looked like something derelict. He said something about the location outside. And I replied, oh I already know all of these houses, inside and out, in this entire area. And he replied asking when I’d been there before, and looked kind of amused and confused, because he had the impression I’d never been there. I said I go there every night in my mall world dreams. He looked at me and laughed , like “of you have a very vivid imagination”. And I was adamant, no I have *really* been here, many, many times. I then described the entire place exactly, inside and out, and said I literally go here every night. And then I said, mall world is a real thing and it’s really possible. And then I explained it as being a skill that is similar to remote viewing.
